portableAcceptance.scope: Isolated portable-EXE settings, focus, keyboard zoom and selection-repeat acceptance; excludes personal installation/handoff checks.

features: U zooms in and O zooms out around the battlefield center; wheel zoom keeps its pointer anchor.
Red WASD and local-two-player blue arrow selection moves immediately, then repeats at 85 ms after a 350 ms delay using real time, independent of game speed and OS repeat.
Release, pause, focus loss, parameter editing and in-app confirmation interrupt held selection; stale held keys do not resume automatically.
Original 30 Hz logic, 0-100x targets, independent display, in-app confirmations and approved hit/lifetime improvements remain unchanged.

sourceScan.scope: Public-source privacy scan coverage, not total Git repository disk usage.

localUpgradeSummary.privacy: Aggregate result only; personal values, file names, directories, raw reports and handoff screenshots are not published.

limitations: 50x/100x and 240 FPS remain targets, not sustained-throughput guarantees; no new full-game Flash-parity claim.
The 105 public EXE checks and 25 private local handoff checks are separate scopes, not a combined public test total.
The local upgrade preserved settings, not the previous match progress.
